name: zimamc
description: The simplest way to run Minecraft servers on ZimaOS and Windows

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w backend & npm run dev -w frontend
scripts.build: npm run build -w frontend && npm run build -w backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build && npm run dist --prefix desktop
